Texts.About:Intro1: Banquet Hall Management is an integrated platform for managing halls, customers, services, and reservations in one place.
Texts.About:Intro2: The system simplifies booking operations, tracks hall availability, and manages customer data and additional services efficiently.
Texts.Support:Ticket:Instructions: Please contact the support team by email or phone to log your complaint and follow up.

Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Reservation:Cannot: The reservation can only be confirmed when it is pending.
The reservation cannot be cancelled in its current state.
The reservation can only be completed when it is fully paid.
The reservation cannot be updated in its current state.
The reservation can only be deleted when it is pending.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Reservation:Schedu: This hall is already booked at the selected time.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:UnderMaintena: The hall cannot be booked because it is under maintenance.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:StatusCannotB: Hall status cannot be set to booked manually. It is derived from reservations.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:StatusInvalid: Invalid hall status. Only available or maintenance are allowed.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Hall:CannotDeleteH: This hall cannot be deleted because it is linked to existing reservations.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Customer:CannotDel: This customer cannot be deleted because they are linked to existing reservations.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Service:CannotDele: This service cannot be deleted because it is used in existing reservations.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Reservation:Cannot: The reservation can only be marked as fully paid when it is confirmed and the total amount has been paid.
Hall entry can only be confirmed when the reservation is fully paid.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Payment:DepositBel: The deposit must be at least 30% of the total reservation amount.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Payment:Installmen: Each installment must be at least 20% of the total reservation amount.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Payment:InvalidRes: A payment cannot be recorded for a reservation in its current status.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Payment:AlreadyRec: This payment has already been recorded.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Payment:AmountInva: The payment amount must be greater than zero.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Finance:AccountNot: The financial account was not found.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:JournalEntry:Unbal: The journal entry is not balanced. Total debits must equal total credits.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:JournalEntry:HasNo: The journal entry must contain at least one line before posting.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:JournalEntryLine:A: Each journal line must have either a debit or a credit amount, but not both.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:JournalEntry:Alrea: This journal entry has already been posted and cannot be modified.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:JournalEntry:NotFo: The journal entry was not found.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Refund:NotAllowed: A refund is not allowed for this reservation.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:Refund:AmountExcee: The refund amount exceeds the outstanding customer liability.
Texts.BanquetHallManagement:HallAccessCard:Not: The hall access card was not found.
